description: Use this when the user asks who filled out their contact form, or wants to see/export leads from their live site. Returns submissions from any <form> built with KleapForm on the app, newest first. Empty list is normal for a brand new site with no visitors yet. Requires the forms:read scope (submissions contain visitor PII) — sessions connected BEFORE this tool shipped don't have it: on a 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE error, tell the user to disconnect and reconnect the Kleap integration (re-authorize) to grant the scope.

app_id.description: The app id to fetch submissions for

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

since.description: Only return submissions at/after this ISO 8601 date, e.g. '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'

name: get_form_submissions
title: Get Form Submissions
